Find the opening hours of the National Museum in Delhi and the ticket price
4:32 AM

The National Museum is open Tue to Sun, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM. It is closed on Mondays and national holidays. Entry for Indian adults is ₹20. Foreign nationals pay ₹500 and students up to class 12 get in free with an I-card. The site also has a notice (dated 29 May 2023) saying the Arms and Armour, Textiles and Jewellery galleries are closed for renovation until further notice. It is worth checking whether that still applies.
